groups.evidence: All registered terrainfeature1–43/geologic1–36/bounds1–49 read. Feature geometry accessor deliberately returns empty for geology windows, distinct from fault traces. groups.acceptance: Preserve exact coordinate systems, full signed native inputs, inclusive boundary policy and widened differences without source authority substitution.
